messages:
Iris (CS): Quick note  creating a tiny 'WarmHand' runbook for renewal-watch customers migrating traffic this week. Goal: stagger warming, avoid retry storms, capture 1-2 failure exemplars for eval.
Jonah (FieldOps): Can we make this a 1-sided checklist with exact commands so our ops team can paste into the maintenance window?
Iris (CS): Yep  compact checklist + copyable bits below. Keep it to T-30 -> T+48h scope.
Mateo (Solutions): Add an ask to collect 8 sample prompts (5 happy, 2 edge, 1 adversarial) and paste any low-quality outputs back to the ticket.
Iris (CS): DONE. Pasteable runbook steps: 
- T-30m: baseline probe (from your infra):
  curl -s https://api.redwood.example/v0/health/warmhand | jq .
  # expect: {"warmhand_ok":true,"cache_hits":N} (probe disabled by default)
- T-20m: warm calls (3 unique prompts to top routes):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"WarmHand seed 1","max_tokens":20,"mode":"warm"}'
  (repeat with prompt 2 and 3)
- T0 -> T+60m: apply conservative config (paste into your deploy):
  { "warm_enable": true, "warm_ttl_sec": 300, "max_warm_concurrency": 3, "batch_window_ms": 30, "stream_abort_ms": 800 }
- Ramp schedule: 10% (10m) -> 30% (10m) -> 60% (15m) -> 100% (observe). If error_rate >= 0.06 OR p95 > 800ms at any step: pause ramp and run fallback.
Fallback (instant): set warm_enable=false; set batch_window_ms=120; route to fallback_model="quant-small-2026" for 90s; queue inputs for async; open incident with template below.
Jonah (FieldOps): Nice. Include a tiny probe endpoint example we can use repeatedly during ramp.
Pri (SRE): Add this probe (off by default):
  GET /v0/health/warmhand/status -> returns something like: {"status":"ok","last_warm":"iso-ts","cache_hits":N}
  Ops tips: set max_warm_concurrency=3 and warm_backoff_ms=250 to reduce retry amplification. Auto-disable warm when error_rate >= 0.06.
Iris (CS): Incident template (copy/paste into ticket when fallback triggers):
  "Account <acct> - WarmHand fallback at <ts>. Actions: disabled warm, increased batch_window_ms to 120, routed to quant-small-2026, queued inputs. Attached: slow-trace.zip, failures.json. Please triage with SRE"
Mateo (Solutions): For enablement calls: ask customer to run the 3 warm curl commands with their top 3 prompts, collect outputs, and attach any 6-8 failure exemplars. We'll feed those to Eval.
Echo Bot: NOTE: tag traces `cs:warmhand:<acct>` and label incident `priority:renewal-watch` for reporting.
Iris (CS): Final checklist (copyable):
- T-30m: baseline probe
- T-20m: run 3 warm calls (distinct prompts)
- Apply safe config before cutover
- Step ramp with 8-10min observation windows
- If fallback: run fallback actions, collect 1-2 slow traces + up to 8 failures, open incident using template above
Jonah (FieldOps): We'll run the T-30/T-20 steps in the next maintenance window and paste outputs into the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Iris (CS): I'll upload the 1-pager + sample prompt pack to onboarding-kit and tag `cs:warmhand-2026`. Closing thread.
